build_imagenet_train_dataset: build an ImageNet training dataset with batch size 128 and data parallelism across devices
build_imagenet_eval_dataset: build an ImageNet evaluation dataset using the TEST split with batch size 100
load_imagenet_split: load a specific ImageNet split with configurable batch size, sharding, and image preprocessing
preprocess_imagenet_image: preprocess an ImageNet image with random crop, flip, bicubic resize, and normalization
normalize_imagenet_image: normalize an ImageNet image to zero mean and unit variance using ImageNet RGB statistics
